title: Remove the discarded initialSyncComplete watch in DashboardBody.build (unnecessary rebuild)

evidence.quote:
// ignore: unused_local_variable — retained for historical documentation.
    final _ = initialSyncComplete;

why: The value is watched, then explicitly discarded into `_`, and the discard is only possible because the team suppressed the unused_local_variable lint. DashboardBody is a ConsumerWidget rebuilt on every dashboard change; it still re-subscribes to and rebuilds on every emission of initialSyncCompleteProvider purely to throw the value away — 'retained for historical documentation' belongs in a plain code comment, not a live ref.watch with a lint bypass.
recommendation: Delete lines 149-150 and 217-218; if the history needs preserving, say so in a plain comment instead of a watched-and-discarded variable.
acceptance_criteria: grep -n initialSyncComplete on dashboard_body.dart returns nothing (or a real conditional use), and the ignore: unused_local_variable comment is gone.
